messages:
ravi: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — putting together an action register for the GPU capacity + autoscaling hit. I sketched tasks below, please claim an item and add ETA. Main goals: short-term headroom, scheduler tuning, quota adjustments, and a testable runbook.

marta: I can take the quota bump with infra. Target EOD Friday. Need the exact numbers for current reserved vs burst usage.

ravi: Thanks. Today snapshot: reserved pools 48 GPUs, avg burst peak 72 GPUs over 2m windows. Headroom target was 20% (should be ~12 spare GPUs) but we observed ~5% (~2-3 GPUs).

jordan: I'll own scheduler tuning. Plan: validate `scheduler.max_pending` and `batch_window_ms` defaults, add a conservative increase for short LLM spikes, then roll canary. ETA Tue COB.

ravi: Action items (initial register):
- quota: bump temporary soft quota + alert on >85% pool util (owner: marta)
- scheduler: tune batch/window and pending limits (owner: jordan)
- headroom guardrail: enforce min free GPU % via autoscale policy (owner: ravi)
- runbook: add step-by-step surge mitigation + rollback (owner: tess)
- telemetry: add a short rule to capture 1m rolling peak + model-level QPS (owner: ops-bot)

tess: I'll update the runbook with exact command snippets and an automated checklist for oncall. Will include commands like `rbctl scale --pool=gpu-large --min=8` and a rollback snippet. ETA Wed AM. :white_check_mark:

marta: For quota I need a short justification string for infra ticket — can someone paste the postmortem snippet I should use?

ravi: Use: "Observed sustained burst demand exceeding reserved pool by ~50% causing scheduler backpressure; temporary soft quota request to restore 20% headroom while we tune autoscaler and scheduler."

ops-bot: created task GPU-487 in Infra tracker (link: https://tracker.internal/gpu-487). Assigned to marta.

jordan: For tuning, I propose:
- `scheduler.max_pending` +20%
- `batch_window_ms` reduce from 50 -> 30 for low-latency routes
- enable conservative preemptive scale for 90th percentile spike
I'll run A/B on a canary pool first and report perf + cost delta.

marta: Claiming quota task. Putting ETA: Fri 18:00 UTC. I'll open infra ticket with Ravi's justification and cc billing for cost signoff.

tess: Runbook PR created: https://git.internal/runbooks/gpu-surge/PR-12 — includes playbook + test plan. Please review.

ravi: Two cross-checks: 1) we need weekly 15m check-ins for 4 weeks to watch for recurrence (owners: everyone) 2) Ops should add an automated incident trigger when headroom <10% for >3m.

ops-bot: added recurring calendar invite "GPU headroom follow-ups" Wednesdays 09:30 UTC for next 4 weeks.

jordan: I'll add a quick smoke test for scheduler changes (load generator script + pass/fail thresholds) and attach to the PR.

marta: Noted on billing — will include cost estimate.

ravi: Good. Can each owner paste final ETA in this thread once set? We'll treat this as canonical action register until tasks close.

tess: ETAs: runbook Wed AM; PR link posted.

jordan: ETA Tue COB for canary tuning + test results.

marta: ETA Fri 18:00 UTC for quota request + billing signoff.

ravi: Thanks everyone. I'll add a short postmortem follow-up note linking these tasks and will ping execs after quota bump. :eyes: If anything slips, flag here and we'll escalate to oncall.

ops-bot: incident summary: GPU surge on 2026-05-14 02:12 UTC, peak 72 GPUs, mitigation tasks opened: GPU-487 (quota), GPU-488 (scheduler), GPU-489 (runbook).
